function.arguments: {"finding": "The customer segment distribution is highly imbalanced between channels: email has 131 returning, 131 loyal, 64 new; paid_search has 153 returning, 26 loyal, 304 new. The email campaign was targeted at loyal and returning customers, but the paid_search group has far more returning customers and far fewer loyal ones. This imbalance means that even after restricting to loyal/returning customers, the comparison is not valid unless we adjust for segment differences. The raw difference in conversion rates (0.4580 vs 0.4581) is not trustworthy because the groups are not comparable.", "implication": "We cannot compute a valid treatment effect using a simple difference in means. We must either stratify by segment, standardize, or model the outcome. Since the groups are imbalanced, and the campaign was not randomized, a raw difference is confounded. The answer must reflect this limitation: we cannot estimate a causal effect with confidence from this observational data without further adjustment. The current estimate is not reliable."}
function.name: note_finding
